about: SimRacingRecs starter catalog (2026-10-22): sim racing gear in five categories — wheelbases (including complete wheel sets), steering wheels and rims, pedals, cockpits and wheel stands, and shifters/handbrakes — from the makers' current stores: fanatec.com, mozaracing.com, simucube.com, simagic.com, thrustmaster.com, logitechg.com, asetek.com/simsports, heusinkveld.com, sim-lab.eu, trakracer.com, nextlevelracing.com and gtomega.com (Playseat as sold by Logitech G). One entry per model: colourways, mount editions (wheel plate vs front & side mount), 2- vs 3-pedal sets and console editions of the same set are merged and their pages listed together; bundles of products already listed, accessories, seats, monitors, button boxes, motion and flight sim gear are left out. Values are blank when not read on a listed page. Columns: shape = category, balance = type, weight = peak torque (wheelbases) or brake load cell, core = platforms, surface = notes.
